organiser.name: Asociación Cultural Mendi Film Festival Elkartea

attendance.note: Organiser-reported: '22.300 espectadores' at the 18th edition (press release 17 Dec 2025), 700 more than the previous year. A Dec 2024 release (Google snippet) gave 9,800 spectators for the 17th edition, so the two releases may count differently.

add_sources.note: Site-wide sponsor footer (crawled Oct 2026), tiers named after peaks: Institutions (Bizkaia, Bilbao, Basque Country); Gailurra (BBK, Euskalduna); Aconcagua (EITB, Ternua, Afesa); Ama Dablam (Adtiva, ETS, La Salve, EMF, Gorka Izagirre); Cervino (Itelazpi); Colaboradores (Pangea, Golem, Club Deportivo, Itsasmuseum); official vehicle Toyota; media partners Deia, SER Radio Bilbao, Desnivel, Sua, El Mundo de los Pirineos, La Ría del Ocio (list cut short).
Google snippet, 11 Dec 2025: La Salve joins as collaborator of the 18th edition.
Google snippet: the 18th edition 'cuenta con el patrocinio de DEIA'.
Press list: Mendi Film Bizkaia Ternua grant co-sponsored by Mendi Film, Ternua and Diputación Foral de Bizkaia.
IG profile links mendifilmfestival.com; the crawled official site and Google results use mendifilm.eus.
Legal notice names ASOCIACIÓN CULTURAL MENDI FILM FESTIVAL ELKARTEA as site owner; euskadi.eus sponsorship tender says the festival is organised by this association.
Basque Government tender: 'Patrocinio del Festival BBK Mendi Film Bilbao Bizkaia organizado por Asociación Cultural Mendi Film Festival Elkartea'.
Release of 17 Dec 2025: '22.300 espectadores acuden a la llamada del Mendi Film'. Mendi Tour spring 2026 reached 9,300 spectators (separate touring programme).
Google snippet: 17th edition (2024) 'crece un 34% con 9.800 espectadores'. Conflicts with the 2025 release's '700 more than last year'.
Google snippet of the official site: 19th edition 4 to 13 December 2026.
Contact form, phone +34 644 40 20 51, office Abandoibarra etorbidea 4, Bilbao. Separate press contact form at /contacto-prensa. No email published.

notes: Organiser corrected to Asociación Cultural Mendi Film Festival Elkartea (the Basque mountaineering federation EMF is a sponsor, not organiser). Sponsor years set to 2026 from the current site footer; most likely also applied in 2025. Ternua (outdoor apparel) is a long-running partner via the Mendi Film Bizkaia Ternua grant. IG @mendifilm is correct.
